SWE II (L3).dsaDepth: Heavy - algorithms and coding are the main signal (Medium–Hard)
rounds: Hiring committee review, then team matching
extraTopics: Clean, tested code and complexity analysis

SWE III (L4).dsaDepth: Heavy - same coding bar as L3, more independence expected
rounds: Hiring committee review, then team matching
extraTopics: Clean, tested code and complexity analysis

Senior SWE (L5).dsaDepth: Heavy - coding still tested; system design and role competence weigh in
rounds: Loop: coding rounds plus a system design round
Hiring committee review, then team matching

Staff SWE (L6).dsaDepth: Moderate - coding present, but scope and impact of past work decide the level
rounds: Loop weighted to large-scale system design, leadership and past-project depth
Hiring committee review, then team matching
Staff SWE (L6).notes: Rarely hired externally at this level.
